messages:
Maria Chen: Postmortem follow-up thread for the vendor-related outage. We need concrete owners, timeboxes, and one-line acceptance criteria for each mitigation so this doesn't recur. Keep incident tasks <14 days where possible.
Ajay Patel: I created a short tracker and seeded cards (link: https://outboards.internal/rw/vendor-mitigations). I'll keep it minimal.
Kenji Sato: I'll own model-registry auth fallback automation. Deliverable: health-probe + manual toggle to route reads to read-only replica + dry-run plan. Due 2026-04-06. Acceptance: can flip to replica with <60s manual action and P95 read latency <250ms in fallback.
Samir Gupta: I'll compile recurring patterns and SLI targets. Deliverable: 1-page summary + SLI additions. Due 2026-04-04. Pattern note (for tracker): token rotation windows + sudden 401 burst -> expensive retry storms.
Elaine Park: I'll update the vendor escalation matrix and PagerDuty contact aliases. Deliverable: updated matrix + oncall alias by 2026-04-07. Acceptance: contact steps validated with one test call.
Maria Chen: CDN-related item? We need reduced amplification from client retries.
Ajay Patel: Priya volunteered in the retro to tune client retry/backoff. Priya (not on thread) will do a PR for backoff config + staging perf test by 2026-04-08. Acceptance: 30% reduction in client retry traffic during simulated 503s.
ops-bot: :robot_face: Task created: "toggle-readonly-replica" assigned to eng-infra. Ticket: INF-4952. ETA: 2 business days.
Kenji Sato: Adding a failure-injection snippet to the runbook for the dry-run:
```
for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer FAKE" https://model-registry.internal/api/v1/models; sleep 0.15; done
```
Samir Gupta: Please ensure each card has an SLI and monitoring play: registry-read P95, replica lag, auth 401-rate. I'll watch telemetry for the dry-run and own escalation.
Maria Chen: Good. One procedural note: mark any non-timeboxed redesigns as "project" so they go to planning; incident actions must be quick and reversible.
incident-bot: Meeting scheduled: Vendor mitigations check-in 1min 32026-04-02 14:00 UTC. Invite sent.
Ajay Patel: I'll raise runbook PR for the fallback steps (checklist: pre-deploy smoke, manual toggle, post-run verification). PR target: 2026-04-05.
Elaine Park: I'll coordinate vendor notice wording for legal/comms and add quarterly vendor health review to the vendor board.
Maria Chen: Everyone: drop "owner  due  acceptance" into the tracker cards now. I'll close this thread after the follow-up meeting.
Ajay Patel: Done (cards updated).
Maria Chen: Thanks all 44d
